title: Copy List with Random Pointer
statement: Each node is [value, random_index]. random_index is -1 when the random pointer is null, otherwise the index of the target node. Deep-copy the list, including random pointers, and return [value, random_value] for each node in order. random_value is null when the pointer is null. Values in the tests are unique, so the random value identifies the target.
hints: The hashmap solution clones every node, then assigns next and random by looking up the originals.
The constant-extra-space solution weaves each clone immediately after its original.
After the weave, original.random.next is the clone of the random target. Then unweave the two lists.

approaches.name: Hash map from original to clone

editorial: Build the original list, then insert a clone after every node. The clone's random pointer is the next node of the original's random pointer, which is that target's clone. A final pass separates the two lists. The returned pairs read the clone values and the clone random values.

examples.explanation: Random targets become the values of those nodes.
The second node points at itself.
